_meta.PURPOSE: Category-specific background music generation prompts for ElevenLabs music_v1

categories.Mystery: Slow atmospheric dark underscore. Sparse instrumentation — solo piano or low sustained strings only. 60–80 BPM. No percussion. Minimal harmonic movement. Convey unresolved tension without urgency.
categories.Discovery: Building orchestral piece with a hopeful, expansive character. Moderate tempo 90–110 BPM. Layered strings entering mid-track, light brass accent. Arc from sparse to full without climax. Background underscore level.
categories.Investigation: Tense, rhythmic chamber piece. Sparse piano or plucked strings with subtle rhythmic pattern. 80–100 BPM. Convey quiet urgency and methodical pacing. No resolution. Underscore only — not foreground.
categories.Ancient Civilizations: Cinematic ambient with period-appropriate ethnic instrumentation. Oud, duduk, lyre, or equivalent ancient strings. Drone or modal harmonic language. 60–80 BPM. No contemporary production textures. Evocative of an ancient world.
categories.Tension: Urgent dissonant string-led underscore. Rising harmonic tension with no release. 90–120 BPM. Rhythmic bow pressure and cluster harmonics acceptable. Build throughout. No resolution at track end.
categories.Resolution: Warm, decelerating orchestral or sparse piano piece. Full strings or solo piano. Sense of emotional landing — not triumphant, not tragic. 70–90 BPM and slowing. Natural fade acceptable.
